optimizedDescription.value: Application FileReader port reads UTF-8 by absolute path, returning null for missing files without importing node:fs.

optimizedContext.value:
# FileReader Port

## Rules

- TypeScript `interface` named `FileReader` with single method `read`. NOT abstract class (no shared constructor invariants).
- `read(absolutePath: string): Promise<string | null>` — UTF-8 text.
- Missing file → return `null`; MUST NOT throw for missing files.
- Non-ENOENT filesystem errors (e.g. permission denied) MUST propagate by throwing. Only `ENOENT` → `null`.
- Implementations MAY accept optional `basePath` at construction. When configured, reject resolved path escaping base via `PathTraversalError`. Escape detection: after resolve, candidate inside when relative from `basePath` empty OR does not start with `..` and is not absolute. Drive-letter case MUST NOT make inside look outside. String prefix of `basePath` + separator MUST NOT be escape test.
- MUST `path.resolve` before read or traversal check so `..` normalised.

## Constraints

- Lives in `application/ports/` per hexagonal rule.
- No direct `node:fs` or I/O at port level.
- Return type `string | null`, not `Buffer` — all reads UTF-8 text.
- `null` sentinel for missing file; no custom missing-file error type.
